name: boss-1
about: Boss Rush: Product Pusher, second version (2026-11-16): a salesman robot in a plated chrome suit with a glowing cyan tie and a briefcase; an angular chrome head with slick moulded hair, a faceplate with cyan eye slits and a fixed cyan grin line. The first version (boss-1-v1.json) had a grinning chrome skull in dark glasses that read as a famous film robot in sunglasses; a second draft with a round chrome helmet and a black visor screen was not used (it would read as a famous duo's helmets). Tripo H3.1 from concept boss01c-pusher-sd-0; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); ten clips retargeted from Tripo's presets (three requests); parts from Tripo segmentation, each bound whole to the bone that owns it.
